description: This file declares functions, structures, and constants for parsing and validating X.509 certificates and their extensions according to RFC 5280, including serial number verification, time parsing, and extension handling.

classes.name: ParsedTbsCertificate
classes.description: Represents the main fields of a DER-encoded TBSCertificate as per RFC 5280, including version, serial number, issuer, validity period, subject, public key info, and optional extensions.

classes.name: ParsedExtension
classes.description: Represents a parsed X.509 extension, including its OID, value, and critical flag.

classes.name: ParsedDistributionPoint
classes.description: Represents a parsed DistributionPoint for CRL distribution points, including fullName, reasons, and CRL issuer.

classes.name: ParsedAuthorityKeyIdentifier
classes.description: Represents the AuthorityKeyIdentifier extension, including key identifier, authority cert issuer, and serial number.

methods.name: VerifySerialNumber
methods.description: Verifies if a serial number is a valid DER-encoded INTEGER up to 20 octets, according to RFC 5280, with optional warnings for non-conforming values.

methods.name: ReadUTCOrGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Reads a Time value (UTC or GeneralizedTime) from a DER parser.

methods.name: ParseValidity
methods.description: Parses the validity period of a certificate, extracting notBefore and notAfter times.

methods.name: ParseCertificate
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded certificate, extracting tbsCertificate, signature algorithm, and signature value.

methods.name: ParseTbsCertificate
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded TBSCertificate, extracting fields like version, serial number, issuer, validity, subject, and extensions.

methods.name: ParseExtension
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded extension, extracting its OID, value, and critical flag.

methods.name: ParseExtensions
methods.description: Parses a sequence of extensions, adding them to a map keyed by OID.

methods.name: ConsumeExtension
methods.description: Removes and retrieves a specific extension by OID from a map of extensions.

methods.name: ParseBasicConstraints
methods.description: Parses the BasicConstraints extension, indicating if the certificate is a CA and the path length constraint.

methods.name: ParseKeyUsage
methods.description: Parses the KeyUsage extension, validating the key usage bits.

methods.name: ParseAuthorityInfoAccess
methods.description: Parses the Authority Information Access extension, extracting access method and location.

methods.name: ParseAuthorityInfoAccessURIs
methods.description: Extracts CA Issuers and OCSP URIs from Authority Information Access extension.

methods.name: ParseCrlDistributionPoints
methods.description: Parses CRL Distribution Points extension, extracting distribution points.

methods.name: ParseAuthorityKeyIdentifier
methods.description: Parses the AuthorityKeyIdentifier extension, extracting key ID, issuer, and serial number.

methods.name: ParseSubjectKeyIdentifier
methods.description: Parses the SubjectKeyIdentifier extension, extracting the key identifier.
